ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a curve graph of product amount changing with time, with the horizontal axis as Time (seconds) and the vertical axis as Product (mg). The curve starts from the origin; at 0 s the product is about 0 mg, and at 2 s the point marked on the graph is about 8 mg. Reasoning: The average reaction rate from 0 to 2 s is equal to the change in product divided by the change in time, namely (8 - 0) mg / (2 - 0) s = 4 mg/s. Rounded to the nearest tenth as required, it is 4.0.
